item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q006_ubiquitin_like_function_divergence","answer":"In SCOPe 2.08, ubiquitin-related domains (family d.15.1.1), UBX domains (d.15.1.2), and Ras-binding domains/RBDs (d.15.1.5) are distinct families within the same Ubiquitin-like superfamily (d.15.1), in the beta-Grasp (ubiquitin-like) fold d.15 and class d. This superfamily assignment supports remote domain-level homology—a probable common evolutionary origin—not merely similar topology. Biologically, it exposes divergence of a conserved beta-grasp scaffold: ubiquitin-related proteins can act as covalent modifiers; UBX domains commonly function as noncovalent adaptors for p97/Cdc48-family ATPases; RBDs recognize activated Ras-family GTPases.\n\nIt is unsafe to transfer any of those family-specific activities across the superfamily. In particular, a UBX or RBD should not be annotated as a ubiquitin-like conjugatable modifier, a UBX-like domain should not be inferred to bind p97 solely from the shared superfamily, and a ubiquitin-related or UBX domain should not be called a Ras effector. Nor should Ras specificity, ubiquitin-chain linkage behavior, degradation signaling, or E1/E2/E3 compatibility be generalized even within a broad family without additional evidence. Illustrative SIDs d1aara_ (Ubiquitin-related), d1wj4a1 (UBX), and d1lfda_ (RalGDS RBD) share superfamily d.15.1 but occupy the three different families; they are lineage witnesses, not automatically the best templates or representatives for every target. Their structures may guide modeling of the conserved core only after target-specific alignment and coverage/quality checks; exact boundaries, termini, loops, interaction surfaces, oligomeric state, and full-length architecture do not transfer automatically. A precise functional annotation requires family-specific sequence/profile and interface-residue conservation plus orthogonal evidence such as a relevant complex structure, biochemical conjugation or binding assay, interaction data, or curated literature.","evidence_used":["Pretrained model knowledge (functional interpretation and evidence requirements)","mcp__scope__search_scop — /api/v1/releases/current; /api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=ubiquitin&mode=auto&limit=50; /api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=UBX&mode=token&limit=20; /api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=Ras&mode=token&limit=50","mcp__scope__get_scop_node — /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/d.15; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/d.15/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/d.15.1; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/d.15.1/parents","mcp__scope__list_scop_children — /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/54236/children?limit=100","mcp__scope__get_scop_domains — /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1aara_; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1aara_/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1aara_/homology; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1wj4a1; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1wj4a1/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1wj4a1/homology; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1lfda_; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1lfda_/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1lfda_/homology"]}]}
